insight: Uzbekistan's performance during hydration breaks in the 2026 World Cup shows that they tend to maintain or slightly lose momentum after these breaks. On average, they experience a small decrease in momentum, with a mean change of -0.033 per minute across all six breaks. Notably, when they were pressing before a break, they lost more momentum, with an average change of -0.100 per minute, and were unable to regain it afterwards. In contrast, when they were not pressing before a break, they lost less momentum, with an average change of -0.020 per minute, suggesting that they may be more effective at managing their energy and strategy during breaks when they are not aggressively pushing forward.
